items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: I think Francis one time and Bill Kress played a job with Mike Trapani

ctx.x: I think Francis one time and Bill Kress played a job with Mike Trapani and he liked that tune and I believe that's where they started playing it. And if I'm not mistaken, Pete Font was at the club that night and wanted to know the name
